declarations.name: UIBrandBlob
declarations.summary: A brand blob tucks one soft lavender shape into a corner of its parent, never behind body text.
declarations.description:
A brand blob tucks one soft lavender shape into a corner of its parent, never behind body text.

Also known as:  blob, corner blob, decoration, background shape, motif.

attributes.name: corner
attributes.description: Which corner of the parent:  `top-left`, `top-right`, `bottom-left`, `bottom-right`.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: `organic` (a soft egg), `mound` (a hill rising from the edge, flat side out) or `wave` (a corner wash with an S-curved edge, as the Brand Montage poster's;  flush in its corner, no overhang by default).

attributes.description: Colour:  `blob` (lavender), `blob-2` (paler, grey-blue), `lilac`, `violet` (between the two), `current` (`currentColor`).

attributes.name: loading

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: `visible="false"` hides it with a short animation (a fade);  `visible` (or `="true"`) brings it back.  Shared by every element.  The platform's `hidden` hides at once, and wins when both are set.

declarations.name: UIBrandColor
declarations.summary: A brand color is a square colour chip:  a label inside, an AA mark, a selected ring, a details tip;  click to copy.
declarations.description:
A brand color is a square colour chip:  a label inside, an AA mark, a selected ring, a details tip;  click to copy.

Also known as:  swatch, color chip, colour chip, color swatch, color sample, color tile.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The colour:  `#RRGGBB`, `#RGB`, `R G B` (0-255) or `oklch(67.7% 0.047 274)`.  Anything else draws no colour.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Token or step name (`brand-500`):  names the chip, and what `copy="token"` copies.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text inside the chip, bottom-left:  `hex` (`8E96B5`), `oklch` (`68 0.05 274`), `name`, or `step` (`500`, the name's last number).  In white or ink, whichever reads better.

attributes.name: contrast
attributes.description: Marks the chip `AA` when white or ink text on it passes 4.5:1.

attributes.name: copy
attributes.description: Click copies the colour:  `hex` (bare `copy` too), `oklch`, `token` (`var(--brand-500)`) or `css` (`--brand-500: #8E96B5;`).  The chip becomes a button, named "Copy <name>".

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: The chosen chip:  a double ring around it.

attributes.name: details
attributes.description: A tip on hover and focus:  name, hex, OKLCH and contrast against white and ink.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Chip size;  `medium` is the default (3em).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Can't be used:  dimmed, out of the tab order, and everything inside it inert;  `aria-disabled`.  Shared by every element;  a family may give it a meaning of its own (`elementSetup.disabled`).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Busy:  dimmed under a loader, and inert;  `aria-busy`.  Shared by every element;  a family may draw its own loader (`elementSetup.loading`).

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: `visible="false"` hides it with a short animation (a fade);  `visible` (or `="true"`) brings it back.  Shared by every element.  The platform's `hidden` hides at once, and wins when both are set.

events.name: ui-copy
events.description: A click copied `value` to the clipboard (`copy`).

cssParts.description: The chip:  a `<button>` with `copy`, else an image.

cssParts.name: copied
cssParts.description: The check shown for a moment after a copy.

cssStates.name: copied
cssStates.description: Just copied:  for about 1.4 seconds after a click.

cssStates.name: choice
cssStates.description: One choice of a `selectable` `<ui-brand-color-set>`:  the host is a radio.

cssStates.name: disabled
cssStates.description: `disabled` is set (or, on a form control, a `<fieldset disabled>` around it).

cssStates.name: loading
cssStates.description: `loading` is set.

cssStates.name: hidden
cssStates.description: `visible="false"`:  hidden, once its animation has run.

declarations.name: UIBrandColorPicker
declarations.summary: A brand color picker chooses a colour on an HSL square and a hue slider, or by typing HSL, hex or OKLCH;  each format copies.
declarations.description:
A brand color picker chooses a colour on an HSL square and a hue slider, or by typing HSL, hex or OKLCH;  each format copies.

Also known as:  color picker, colour picker, color chooser, hsl picker, swatch picker, eyedropper, color input.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The colour, `#RRGGBB` (upper-case;  anything the hex field accepts is read:  `#abc`, `142 150 181`, `hsl(250 54% 55%)`, `oklch(67.7% 0.047 274)`).  Reflects;  default `#8E96B5`.  The attribute's FIRST value is the form's reset value.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name:  the form gets `value`.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Name of the picker for screen readers (its group);  default:  what names it, else `Colour`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Faded;  nothing in it can be used (copying neither).

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Shows the colour but can't change it;  copying still works, and it's still submitted.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Busy:  dimmed under a loader, and inert;  `aria-busy`.  Shared by every element;  a family may draw its own loader (`elementSetup.loading`).

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: `visible="false"` hides it with a short animation (a fade);  `visible` (or `="true"`) brings it back.  Shared by every element.  The platform's `hidden` hides at once, and wins when both are set.

events.name: ui-input
events.description: The colour changed while choosing:  each drag step, hue step, key or valid keystroke.  A handler that re-sets `value` wins.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: A choice was committed:  a drag or hue drag ends, a key on the square, Enter or leaving a field -- when the colour differs from the last commit.

events.name: ui-copy
events.description: A row's copy button wrote `value` to the clipboard:  `hsl(...)`, `#RRGGBB` or `oklch(...)`.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ value: string, format: "hsl" | "hex" | "oklch", originalEvent?: Event }>

slots.description: Content under the rows, e.g. family chips (`Or start from a family`).

slots.name: header

slots.name: actions

declarations.name: UIBrandColorRange
declarations.summary: A brand color range is a 17-step ladder of shades made from one base colour, the base colour's step ringed.
declarations.description:
A brand color range is a 17-step ladder of shades made from one base colour, the base colour's step ringed.

Also known as:  color scale, colour scale, color ramp, shades, tints and shades, color ladder, palette row.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The base colour (`#8E96B5`, `R G B`, `oklch(...)`).  It lands EXACTLY on its step;  none:  no ladder.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: The step the base colour sits at;  `auto`:  the step nearest its lightness.

attributes.name: vibrancy
attributes.description: How colourful the steps are, in percent of the base colour's (the Chooser's Vibrancy):  0 is grey.

attributes.name: hue-shift
attributes.description: Degrees the hue drifts toward the dark end:  the darker steps lean toward a neighbouring hue.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Token prefix:  chips are named `<name>-25` ... `<name>-975`, and `css()` writes those tokens.  None:  `color`.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text inside every chip, as `<ui-brand-color label>`.

attributes.name: contrast
attributes.description: Marks `AA` on the steps text reads clearly on.

attributes.name: copy
attributes.description: A click on a chip copies it, as `<ui-brand-color copy>`.

attributes.name: details
attributes.description: Each chip's details tip, on hover and focus.

attributes.name: numbers
attributes.description: Step numbers under the chips:  `shown`, or `none` (no numbers, nor their row:  a page numbering many ladders once, in a header row).

attributes.name: strip
attributes.description: A small strip of 17 dots instead of chips (the Chooser's folded Variants header).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Can't be used:  dimmed, out of the tab order, and everything inside it inert;  `aria-disabled`.  Shared by every element;  a family may give it a meaning of its own (`elementSetup.disabled`).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Busy:  dimmed under a loader, and inert;  `aria-busy`.  Shared by every element;  a family may draw its own loader (`elementSetup.loading`).

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: `visible="false"` hides it with a short animation (a fade);  `visible` (or `="true"`) brings it back.  Shared by every element.  The platform's `hidden` hides at once, and wins when both are set.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: The ladder changed (`value`, `anchor`, `vibrancy`, `hue-shift`):  not on first render.

declarations.name: UIBrandComposer
declarations.summary: A brand composer is the box where you describe an app in plain words and cast it:  a serif text box, tool chips, a keyboard hint and a round Cast button.
declarations.description:
A brand composer is the box where you describe an app in plain words and cast it:  a serif text box, tool chips, a keyboard hint and a round Cast button.

Also known as:  composer, prompt box, prompt input, chat input, message box, spell box, command box.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The text.  Attribute:  the starting (and reset) value;  property:  the live value, as `<ui-textarea>`'s.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name:  the form gets `value`.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint shown while empty;  default `Describe what you want to build…`, `placeholder=""` none.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Lines tall when empty;  the box grows as you write.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Name of the text box for screen readers;  default:  what names the host (`aria-label`, `<label for>`), else `eyebrow`, else `Your spell`.

attributes.name: eyebrow
attributes.description: Small mono caps line above the text box (`Try a spell`);  or `slot="eyebrow"`.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Keyboard hint beside the tools;  default `⌘↵ to cast` (`Ctrl+↵ to cast` off Apple devices), `hint=""` none.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: `medium` (the app's Build box:  17px text, small shadow) or `large` (the marketing hero's:  19px text, larger shadow and radius).

attributes.name: casting
attributes.description: Busy:  the Cast button spins and casting is paused (the text stays editable).  The page sets it while it builds, and clears it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Faded;  can't be typed in or cast, left out of the form.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Shows its text but can't be typed in;  still cast and submitted (unlike `disabled`).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Busy:  dimmed under a loader, and inert;  `aria-busy`.  Shared by every element;  a family may draw its own loader (`elementSetup.loading`).

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: `visible="false"` hides it with a short animation (a fade);  `visible` (or `="true"`) brings it back.  Shared by every element.  The platform's `hidden` hides at once, and wins when both are set.

events.name: ui-input
events.description: The text changed (every keystroke).  A handler that re-sets `value` wins.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: The user committed an edit (left the text box changed).

events.name: ui-cast

slots.name: eyebrow

slots.name: tools

cssParts.name: bar

attributes.description: Can't be used:  dimmed, out of the tab order, and everything inside it inert;  `aria-disabled`.  Shared by every element;  a family may give it a meaning of its own (`elementSetup.disabled`).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Busy:  dimmed under a loader, and inert;  `aria-busy`.  Shared by every element;  a family may draw its own loader (`elementSetup.loading`).

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: `visible="false"` hides it with a short animation (a fade);  `visible` (or `="true"`) brings it back.  Shared by every element.  The platform's `hidden` hides at once, and wins when both are set.

declarations.name: UIBrandPhone
declarations.summary: A brand phone frames live app content as a phone:  a status bar on top, the app below.
declarations.description:
A brand phone frames live app content as a phone:  a status bar on top, the app below.

Also known as:  phone frame, device frame, phone mockup, device mockup, app preview, mobile preview.
